Scene: ant's-eye view, camera low at ant height, at the way into the Warm Amber nest: a narrow, winding canyon of red-brown earth under a near-black maroon night sky. Its walls are porous, pitted soil in rust, terracotta and dark maroon. Ball-topped stalks with pale-gold heads stand along the walls; a large dry mushroom with a flat tan cap and a twisted stem leans over the path, small drops of amber resin hanging from its rim; dark soil spires rise further back; a pitted soil mound and a thorny succulent sit by the path. Focal point: the nearest beam beside the path, its pool of light and the vines round its foot. Make it look like a still from the same game, a real-time render, not a painting. Everything (walls, floor, plants, objects) is built from countless small opaque points and splats, like a Gaussian-splat capture: slight differences in tone keep each material's own colour and grain; no smooth surfaces, no outlines. Points are fine and dense near the camera, smaller and sparser far away; the floor is a carpet of fine points. The passage is narrow, a few ant-widths wide, with walls close on both sides. Night, low but controlled brightness: the darkest areas sit near black, yet every shape stays readable. Light, in this place's own colour (warm amber-gold; no cyan, teal or blue anywhere): one thin guiding thread of light hangs in the air and leads deeper in, in straight stretches with a few sharp turns; one or two thin straight vertical beams stand beside the path, each with a soft pool of light at its foot. Solid vines of dark points, lit by the beams but not glowing, wrap round the beams' feet and climb the walls. Plants glow only faintly, as if breathing. Mature and restrained: one clear focal point carries the detail, the rest falls into calm masses of points; limited palette. No glitter, sparkles, lens flares, bokeh balls, neon, over-saturation, HDR look, noisy clutter, random extra objects or repeated tiny details; the air is clear apart from a few faint motes. Wide 16:9 landscape. No text, no interface, no frame.
